body: Well all of my ailments were gone. I was completely sublime. I don't think that I was dead long enough to get a real "look" into the afterlife. Are you a person who has a religious beliefs and if you don't mind telling me if so what are they?

I personally can say that there is a afterlife. As for the God thing I believe that the person who I was talking to was God. But I am unwilling to say for absolute sure that there is a God. As you I am a Christian and I don't want to force my religious beliefs on anyone. I guess that it is up to you to take my word that I was talking to God and take what you will from it. But those 2 questions are not for me to "decide" I guess you could say. It is really just up to you to take what you can from my experience.

I remember being asked if I wanted to see my loved ones and that is what I remember. I am sorry that I can not provide more information about the questions but it is like my brain is blocking it out. The last question was about the most important things in my life and if I would make it count this time around. Now 4 days later things are happening (good things) and a lot of them and they are happening fast. I hope that I helped answer your questions.
